text.p: Following are the main stories in Croatian newspapers on Thursday.
- President Tudjman announces the date of the elections as being April 13.
- Vukovar: Hundreds of Serbs queue for Croatian papers.
- Some 30,000 Croat expatriots have returned to the country, says immigration minister Marijan Petrovic.
- The exploatation of gas from the Adriatic to start in December of 1998, following extensive three-dimensional scanning of about 1,500 square meters of the gas-rich underwater soil.
- Reconstruction and development minister Jure Radic announces in an interview the completion of the Zagreb-Split motorway in less than a decade.

- The U.S. hopes that Croatia's decision to purchase Airbus planes was made on an economic and not on a political basis, says in an interview U.S. ambassador to Croatia, Peter Galbraith. -- Zagreb Newsroom, 385-1-4557075
